exportRequested: Export request created! You will receive an email when it is ready.
title: GDPR & data protection
description: Download your data and manage your data rights
fullDownloadSub: Download all your data under GDPR article 20
fullDownloadText: A full data export includes all your personal data: profile, clients, projects, time entries, tasks, invoices, prepaid packages and settings. The export is processed in the background, and you receive an email with a download link when it is ready.
overviewSub: Number of records in your account
deletionText: You can delete your account and all associated data from <link>Settings</link> under "Danger zone".
retentionNote: Note: Under the Danish Bookkeeping Act (Bogføringsloven), certain accounting-related data (invoices and related time entries) must be kept for at least 5 years. This data will be anonymised after the account is deleted.
deletionHow: When an account is deleted, data is handled as follows:
deletionProfile: Profile and sign-in details are deleted immediately
deletionClients: Clients, projects and tasks are deleted within 30 days
deletionInvoices: Invoices and related time entries are anonymised and kept for 5 years
